BOTDEFENSE::bot_categories
Description
This iRules command returns the list of category names to which
the current client belongs. These categories are determined by
the anomalies found for the respective client. Note these
categories are additional to the bot signature category which
is applicable if a bot signature was found.
Syntax
BOTDEFENSE
::
bot_categories
Examples
when
BOTDEFENSE_ACTION
{
foreach
{
cat
}
[
BOTDEFENSE
::
bot_categories
]
{
log
local0.
"Found category: $cat"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
BOTDEFENSE_ACTION
Introduced: BIGIP-14.1.0
